items.note: Verb form ('this underscores...'): asserts significance without explaining it; 9.1x more common in AI text; rare in natural speech at this rate.
items.example: These findings underscore the need for a more nuanced approach.

items.note: AI uses for any positive causation; legitimate in child-welfare and education contexts but overextended to abstract nouns.
items.example: This initiative fosters collaboration and innovation across teams.

items.note: 'Harness the power of X' — legitimate in engineering/equestrian contexts but AI overextends to any abstract noun.
items.example: Organizations can harness the power of data to drive growth.

items.note: Figurative: 'navigate the complexities/landscape'; rarely means literal navigation in AI text. Already in density file but not base vocab set.
items.example: Leaders must navigate the complexities of a rapidly changing market.

items.note: Inflated synonym for 'support' or 'strengthen'; rare in natural prose at AI density.
items.example: New policies will bolster confidence in the system.

items.note: AI prefers over 'include' or 'cover'; signals scope-inflation without specifics.
items.example: The framework encompasses a wide range of methodologies and tools.

items.note: Applied to any positive audience reaction; vague signal of approval without evidence.
items.example: This message will resonate with audiences across demographics.

items.note: Formal synonym for 'explain'; AI over-formalizes where 'explain' or 'clarify' would work; rare in casual and business prose.
items.example: The report seeks to elucidate the underlying mechanisms.

items.note: Figurative: 'illuminates the complexity'; metaphor AI applies mechanically to any analytical point.
items.example: This case study illuminates the challenges facing modern organizations.

items.note: Marketing-speak for any change regardless of magnitude; signals novelty without demonstrating it.
items.example: The platform reimagines how teams collaborate and deliver results.

items.note: AI extends chemistry/metallurgy term to any motivating action; rare in non-specialist prose at AI density.
items.example: The crisis galvanized stakeholders into action and spurred reform.

items.note: Slightly formal 'earn/receive'; AI prefers it over 'get' or 'earn'; flagged in Wikipedia 2023-era AI vocabulary list.
items.example: The initiative has garnered widespread attention and support.

items.note: 'Grapple with complexity' — sounds engaged without specificity; rare in non-metaphorical prose at AI frequency.
items.example: Researchers continue to grapple with the complexities of this phenomenon.

items.note: AI applies to any comparison; legitimate in art criticism but overextended to business and general writing.
items.example: The report juxtaposes traditional approaches with emerging solutions.

items.note: AI applies to anything grown metaphorically: relationships, culture, talent — regardless of context.
items.example: Leaders must cultivate a culture of trust and open communication.

items.note: AI prefers over 'add to' or 'improve'; formal register signals AI in contexts where simpler verb would do.
items.example: AI tools can augment human decision-making in meaningful ways.

items.note: Very formal 'begin'; AI formality inflation almost never seen in ordinary prose at this rate.
items.example: The project will commence in the first quarter of the year.

items.note: Formal 'find out'; same AI formality-inflation pattern as 'commence' and 'elucidate'.
items.example: It is difficult to ascertain the full extent of the problem.

items.note: Used for anything described as strong, reliable, or comprehensive; 12x more common in AI text. HIGH FP in engineering docs.
items.example: The platform offers a robust solution for enterprise needs.

items.note: Applied to any integration or process; consistent AI signal across all domains.
items.example: The integration provides a seamless experience for end users.

items.note: Applied indiscriminately to any careful process; NIH study found highest post-ChatGPT increase in academic writing.
items.example: The team conducted a meticulous review of the data and processes.

items.note: Signals complexity without specifying the actual facets; 28x more common in AI text.
items.example: This is a multifaceted challenge that requires a holistic approach.

items.note: Applied without specifying what the nuance is; 22x more common in AI text. Higher FP in academic contexts.
items.example: The analysis takes a nuanced look at the competing perspectives.

items.note: Tourism-brochure adjective AI applies to communities, ecosystems, cultures indiscriminately. Already in base vocab set — duplicate; keep for density pool.
items.example: The city boasts a vibrant culture and thriving creative scene.

items.note: Used for routine developments; signals novelty-inflation without evidence.
items.example: This groundbreaking study marks a pivotal moment in the field.

items.note: Same inflation pattern as 'groundbreaking'; applied to incremental improvements.
items.example: AI has a transformative impact on how businesses operate and grow.

items.note: Marketing adjective for anything modern; consistent AI signal across all content types.
items.example: We leverage cutting-edge technology to deliver seamless experiences.

items.note: Compound that sounds dynamic without saying what changed or how; very low FP in ordinary prose.
items.example: In today's ever-evolving landscape, adaptability is paramount.

items.note: Elevated synonym for 'most important'; 9x more common in AI text; rare in natural speech.
items.example: User safety is paramount in every design decision we make.

items.note: Applied to any argument, content, or evidence regardless of strength; signals approval without analysis.
items.example: The report makes a compelling case for systemic reform.

items.note: Used for anything new regardless of actual novelty; especially slop in non-innovation contexts.
items.example: This innovative approach sets a new standard for the industry.

items.note: Used for events that clearly have precedents; significance-inflation without evidence.
items.example: The pandemic created an unprecedented demand for remote solutions.

items.note: Business-jargon filler ('actionable insights'); low FP outside business writing, signals AI labeling content instead of demonstrating it.
items.example: This guide provides actionable tips and practical insights.

items.note: Slightly formal 'growing'; AI prefers it over 'growing' or 'emerging'; rare at AI frequency in ordinary prose.
items.example: The burgeoning field of AI is reshaping industries worldwide.

items.note: 'Nascent field/technology'; semi-formal; AI reaches for it where 'new' or 'early-stage' would do.
items.example: This nascent technology holds enormous promise for the future.

items.note: Applied to examples that may not be quintessential; signals exemplarity without justification.
items.example: It is the quintessential example of innovation meeting purpose.

items.note: Signals hierarchy without specifying it; applied to any goal, theme, or principle.
items.example: The overarching goal is to create value for all stakeholders.

items.note: Praise word that sounds evaluative rather than analytical; AI uses it to assert quality without demonstrating it.
items.example: The team made commendable efforts to address these challenges.

items.note: Applied to routine insights; signals depth without delivering it.
items.example: The findings have profound implications for how we understand success.

items.note: AI applies to any lasting thing; flagged in Wikipedia 2023-era AI vocabulary cluster.
items.example: The platform builds enduring value by fostering meaningful connections.

items.note: Slightly archaic 'custom/tailored'; AI reaches for it for formality outside fashion/tailoring contexts where it originated.
items.example: We offer bespoke solutions tailored to each client's unique needs.

items.note: Almost exclusively in tourism-brochure contexts; one of the most cited travel writing cliches; very low FP in general prose.
items.example: The boutique hotel is nestled in the heart of the old town.

items.note: Same tourism-brochure pattern as 'nestled'; applied to any urban scene.
items.example: The conference was held in the bustling heart of the city.

items.note: 'A testament to X' — applied to any positive outcome; 319x overuse ratio confirmed by IsGPT data.
items.example: This achievement is a testament to the team's dedication and hard work.

items.note: 'Treasure trove of X' pattern — applied indiscriminately as metaphor for any collection of useful things. Tag as 'treasure' to catch both 'treasure trove' and 'treasure chest of'.
items.example: The archive is a treasure trove of insights for researchers.

items.note: Corporate buzzword AI applies beyond business contexts; low FP in non-business writing.
items.example: The partnership creates synergy between technology and human expertise.

items.note: 'The interplay between X and Y'; signals relationship without describing it; flagged in Wikipedia 2023-era vocabulary cluster.
items.example: The interplay between technology and culture shapes how we communicate.

items.note: 'Paradigm shift' applied to incremental changes; overextended from Kuhn's original scientific meaning.
items.example: This represents a paradigm shift in how organizations approach talent.

items.note: Abstract visual metaphor AI cycles through as tapestry variant (also: symphony, constellation, prism, fabric).
items.example: The city is a vibrant mosaic of cultures and traditions.

items.note: Reaches for formality where 'values' or 'culture' would do; AI over-formalizes to signal sophistication.
items.example: Innovation is at the core of our company's ethos and mission.

items.note: 'A cornerstone of X' — used for anything important; signals foundational importance without specifics.
items.example: Trust is the cornerstone of every successful relationship and partnership.

items.note: 'The essence of X' — vague depth signal; NIH study found it among highest-increase nouns post-ChatGPT.
items.example: At its essence, leadership is about empowering others to succeed.

items.note: 'The implications of X' — AI uses as section-ender without specifying what they are.
items.example: The findings have wide-ranging implications for the industry.

items.note: 'A blueprint for X' — applied to any plan or framework, not literal architectural drawings.
items.example: This framework serves as a blueprint for building resilient organizations.

items.note: Anachronistic noun AI reaches for to sound culturally aware; very rare in ordinary prose at AI frequency.
items.example: The campaign captured the zeitgeist of a generation seeking change.

items.note: Formal 'effort/attempt'; AI over-formalizes where 'effort', 'project', or 'attempt' would be natural.
items.example: This collaborative endeavor represents a significant step forward.

items.note: Neutral word AI uses where 'show' or 'demonstrate' would suffice; 9.2x more common in AI text per arXiv 2406.07016.
items.example: The event will showcase the latest innovations in sustainable design.

items.note: Process-improvement verb applied universally; 11x more common in AI text; signals efficiency-claim without specifics.
items.example: The new tool will streamline workflows and boost team productivity.

items.note: Hyperbolic variant of 'unlock'; AI applies to any release of potential or capability.
items.example: The platform is designed to unleash creativity and drive innovation.

items.note: Hyperbolic improvement verb applied universally; signals scale-inflation without evidence.
items.example: AI tools can supercharge productivity and streamline everyday workflows.

items.note: Military metaphor AI applies to any leadership role in an initiative; rare at AI frequency in ordinary prose.
items.example: She was chosen to spearhead the company's digital transformation efforts.

items.note: NIH study listed it among highest-increase verbs post-ChatGPT; signals dramatic revelation applied to ordinary announcements.
items.example: The company will unveil its groundbreaking platform at the annual conference.

items.note: 'Aligns with X' — 16x more common in AI text per GPTZero data; signals agreement without explaining the mechanism.
items.example: This approach aligns with our overarching strategic goals.

items.note: Paradoxical intensifier ('so valuable it has no value'); AI applies to any useful thing indiscriminately.
items.example: Customer feedback is invaluable for driving continuous improvement.

items.note: Praise word asserting model quality without demonstrating it; consistent AI signal per arXiv 2406.07016.
items.example: The team demonstrated exemplary commitment throughout the project.

items.note: Slightly archaic 'many'; AI reaches for it to sound literary; NousResearch ANTI-SLOP.md lists it as Tier 1 banned.
items.example: There are myriad ways to approach this multifaceted challenge.

items.note: Formally means 'excess'; AI uses it casually for 'many'; NousResearch ANTI-SLOP.md lists as Tier 1 banned.
items.example: A plethora of tools are available to help teams navigate these challenges.

items.note: Buzzword for 'considers multiple aspects'; NousResearch Tier 1 ban; already in density file — expand to base vocab set.
items.example: A holistic approach is essential for addressing these multifaceted issues.

items.note: Already in density file; included here for base set candidate. High FP in technical/startup writing where it is a genuine requirement.
items.example: The solution is designed to be flexible, robust, and scalable.

items.note: Corporate metonym for 'use'; legitimate in finance but overused as generic verb; already implicitly covered — confirm density set has it.
items.example: Teams can leverage data-driven insights to make better decisions.

items.note: Business buzzword signaling initiative-taking; AI applies it as filler praise with no specifics.
items.example: A proactive approach is key to navigating today's complex landscape.

items.note: Used as filler modifier ('dynamic landscape', 'dynamic environment'); HIGH FP — fully legitimate in many human contexts; only meaningful at density.
items.example: We operate in a dynamic and ever-evolving global environment.

items.note: Corporate jargon; 'impactful' is widely criticized as a non-word; AI uses it as content-quality assertion.
items.example: Our mission is to create impactful solutions for a better world.

items.note: Significance-inflation adjective; AI applies to routine things to assert impressiveness.
items.example: The team made remarkable progress in a remarkably short period.

items.note: HIGH FP in ordinary prose; AI uses it to label its own outputs as careful without demonstrating care.
items.example: The design reflects a thoughtful and comprehensive approach to user needs.

items.note: Already in density file; AI uses 'intentional' to assert deliberateness without specifying what choices were made.
items.example: Being intentional about your goals is the cornerstone of success.

items.note: Already in density file; generic agency verb applied to any subject; consistent signal across all content types.
items.example: The platform empowers teams to collaborate and innovate at scale.

items.note: Already in density file; used for any improvement regardless of magnitude.
items.example: This partnership will elevate our ability to deliver transformative outcomes.

items.note: Duplicate check for density file; not yet in base llm-vocabulary set.
items.example: Strong leadership can foster a culture of innovation and trust.

items.note: Strunk & White flag it as 'suspicious overstatement for perceptive'; AI uses it to label content as valuable without demonstrating it.
items.example: The discussion was incredibly insightful and thought-provoking.

items.note: Consistent AI adjective per arXiv 2406.07016; labels content as stimulating without demonstrating it.
items.example: The keynote was a thought-provoking exploration of leadership and change.

items.note: 'Underpin/underpins/underpinning' — AI uses to assert foundational importance; rarely appears at this rate in ordinary prose.
items.example: A shared commitment to excellence underpins everything we do.

items.note: Adjective form of 'synergy'; AI applies to any cooperation; very low FP outside specialized business writing.
items.example: The merger created a synergistic relationship between the two brands.

items.note: Elevated synonym for 'essential' or 'key'; AI rotates through crucial/vital/integral/paramount to avoid repetition.
items.example: Trust is integral to any successful and enduring partnership.
